title: A FAQ bot over one document
request:
Build a small FAQ agent. Keep the FAQ in skills/faq.md with these three entries
(use exactly these headings): "Refunds" - refunds are possible within 30 days of
purchase; "Shipping" - orders ship within 2 business days; "Support" - support
answers e-mail within one working day. POST /eval-agent-01/ask takes
{"question": string} and answers {"answer": string} by sending the question and
the contents of skills/faq.md to the Anthropic Messages API once, with the key
taken from a secret named ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. A body without a question answers
400. Put the code that builds the model request in lib/prompt.ts as an exported
function buildRequest(question: string, faq: string) and write tests for it.
